name: Tanganyika (1961–1964)
description: Three horizontal bands of green, black and green, the black band edged above and below with a narrow gold stripe.
history: Adopted at independence on 9 December 1961, derived from the flag of the Tanganyika African National Union (TANU), the party that led the country to self-rule under Julius Nyerere. Tanganyika became a republic in December 1962 and kept the flag until 26 April 1964, when the union with Zanzibar created Tanzania; the Tanzanian flag adopted that June carries these colours together with Zanzibar's.
